description.en: Each question has been recounted from the original survey workbooks. Only summary results are included, without individual responses.

source_documents.file: 数据采集与分析/生产数据/Results and discussion-生产者-CN.docx

methodology.aggregation: Each item is summarized separately. No dimension index is created and no reverse coding is applied.
methodology.validity_rule: Accept only finite integer numeric values from 1 to 5. Blank values and other codes are excluded separately for each item; do not delete whole respondents from all questions.
methodology.count_validation: Each 1–5 distribution sums to valid_n; valid_n + missing_n + invalid_n equals sample_n.
methodology.source_privacy: Only aggregate counts and statistics are included; no response rows, respondent identifiers or demographics are exported.

label.en: Choose a stall when hardware is ¥1–5 cheaper than at a supermarket

question.text_zh: 如果市集摊贩的五金产品价格比商超便宜 1–5 元，我更倾向于选择摊贩而非商超。

text.zh: A3 有一个回答记为 0，另一个记为 6，都超出了 1–5 的量表范围，因此这题按 88 份有效回答计算。其余选定的消费者题各有 90 份有效回答。无法确认这两个异常值原本想表达什么，因此未作修正。
text.en: A3 has one answer coded 0 and another coded 6, both outside the 1–5 scale. They are excluded, leaving 88 valid answers; the other selected consumer questions each have 90. The two values have not been corrected because their intended meaning is unknown.

text.zh: 原始工作簿 B3 列（N2:N91）的均值为 4.1444，但消费数据分析结果-12.12(1).docx 第 68 段等处写的是 3.64。图表使用原始工作簿中标为 B3 的这一列重新计算的结果：4.1444。
text.en: The mean for B3 in the original workbook (N2:N91) is 4.1444. The analysis document gives 3.64 in paragraph 68 and elsewhere. The charts use 4.1444, recalculated from the workbook column labeled B3.

limitations.zh: 这些比例只描述本次受访者的回答，不能代表所有市集或城市居民。
limitations.en: These percentages describe the people surveyed. They do not represent all markets or urban residents.

limitations.zh: 消费者和商户回答的题目不同，不能直接比较两组的分数高低。
limitations.en: Consumers and merchants answered different questions, so their scores cannot be compared directly.

limitations.zh: 均值是对 1–5 级回答的概括。同意比例指选择 4 或 5 的人数占比，不是实际购买或调整价格的比例。
limitations.en: The mean summarizes answers on the ordered 1–5 scale. Agreement is the percentage choosing 4 or 5, not the percentage who actually bought something or changed a price.

limitations.zh: 这些是一次调查中由受访者自己报告的回答，可以描述样本情况，但不能证明因果关系或市场是否达到均衡。
limitations.en: These are self-reported answers from a single survey. They describe the sample but cannot establish cause and effect or show whether the market is in equilibrium.

limitations.zh: 这里只统计预先选定的 10 道题，每题单独计算，没有验证完整问卷量表，也没有把题目合成为维度分数。
limitations.en: This summary covers 10 questions selected in advance. Each is reported separately; the full survey scale has not been validated, and no combined scores have been created for its dimensions.
